tool_args.rationale: Fit competing sink-dependent fast and slow response couplings numerically. The observations constrain both the initial sink dependence and delayed reversal; fresh confirmation will test whether the selected coupling generalizes.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Eleven observations now span short and long horizons; revise the coupling before buying more measurements.

considered_alternatives.option: Pure dual-exponential response proportional to input
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: It omits the pronounced sink-gradient dependence in the pilot.
The long-horizon observations reverse sign, and the earlier additive adaptation fit failed confirmation.
The observations do not show chaotic sign oscillations, and the refutations do not rule out all smooth stationary couplings.
